stem: This poem is mostly about a young man who —

options.label: F
options.text: follows people going west in search of gold and tries different locations without success

options.label: G
options.text: looks for a better alternative to a job that he does not enjoy doing and becomes a gold prospector

options.label: H
options.text: goes west in hopes of finding gold and after several unsuccessful attempts finally realizes a better way to earn money

options.label: J
options.text: tries the same method for finding gold and is unsuccessful because of his unwillingness to change
